verdict.rationale: Beglaubigt.de is a founder-facing legal and corporate-services platform covering incorporation, notarization, and signer management, so generating fundraising instruments is a fair question for it. The evidence covers GmbH/UG incorporation, notarization of documents the user uploads, translations, apostilles, and tax and trade registration. Nothing shows standard-term SAFE or convertible-note templates, or generating such documents rather than notarizing user-supplied ones.
